products.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-5 · silicon rev3.x
products.summary: 5 英寸 720×1280 MIPI-DSI / GT911，32 MiB Flash/PSRAM；输入数字子集，DSI显示尚未实现。

interfaces.name: TF · SDMMC
interfaces.notes: GPIO45 low active supply; default64MiB FAT32; original-firmware mount unverified.

limitations: MIPI-DSI / DPI 图像传输未实现，当前不生成替代 framebuffer；产品尺寸/分辨率是硬件知识，不能当作显示运行通过。
Goodix只在0x5D应答；未发明可控INT引脚来选择0x14。GT9271保留9271器件身份，复用官方BSP声明兼容的单点报告子集。
GT911 触摸报告数字子集、I2C GPIO7/8、GPIO35 BOOT 已实现；多点、复杂配置与完整原厂界面未验证。
TF 默认64MiB FAT32与已有P4 SDMMC数字模型；独立原厂文件系统挂载、C6无线、CSI、USB、音频模拟、Ethernet及模拟电源未验收。
此配置使用虚拟 silicon rev3.01，仅用于匹配原始镜像范围；不是实物PCB修订声明，实际芯片应单独识别。
原始出厂镜像固定提交/实际SHA，分区和每个ESP段checksum/SHA已审计；simulationVerified=false，未做本次原厂启动或实机验收。
UIFlow1/2：本轮官方型号README/资源页没有列出精确目标镜像；上游专项核验未知。Xiaozhi可能作为官方Brookesia内部应用出现，但这不证明独立上游镜像可复用。
3D 来源：official-cad；生产Three加载器/原生尺寸/屏幕射线/展开复位已检验；部分结构和光学尺寸有明确限制，未宣称浏览器WebGL或实物装配通过。
Model: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Model: Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.

Model: Optional camera, purchased battery/header accessories and packaging differences are recorded in product knowledge. This mechanical asset depicts only components present in the retained manufacturer file.
Model: Only actual output uses framebuffer. Physical BOOT/PWR targets require separately calibrated source positions; product keyboard/button controls remain available.
Model: Colors are approximate and native component groups preserve exact source placement; no current PCB revision or internal electrical validation inferred from CAD.
Model: Published viewing opening62.28×110.32mm differs from720×1280 pixelaspect. Runtime uses62.055×110.32mm inside it; active area calibration remains unresolved.
